y-m-32-06.material: Fumana intsalela xa f(x)=x²⁰−3x+2 (x kumandla angama-20 ukususa 3x kunye no-2) ihlulwa ngu-x²−1. f(x)=(x²−1)·Q(x)+R(x), kwaye Q(x) yipolynomial enamanani apheleleyo njengemilinganiselo. Abafundi abahlanu basebenzise iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Indlela A: Bhala R(x)=ax+b, faka x=1 no-x=−1 ufumane f(1)=a+b no-f(−1)=−a+b, ufumane a no-b. Indlela B: Phatha x²=1, tshintsha x²⁰=(x²)¹⁰=1, ucinge ukuba f ilingana no-−3x+3. Indlela C: Kuba f(1)=0 no-f(−1)=6, thatha umndilili wamaxabiso omabini, 3, njengentsalela. Indlela D: Yenza ukwahlula okude kwedigri ye-20 ukuya ekupheleni. Indlela E: Kuba f(1)=0, iyahlulwa ngu-x−1, ngoko cinga ukuba iyahlulwa nangu-x²−1 uthathe intsalela ibe yi-0.
